0022600173.text: The Pistons, 5-1 and first in the Central, host the 76ers, who are 6-1, first in the East, and riding a three-game winning streak. Detroit leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 106-93 win in Philadelphia on October 25, and the Pistons won the 2025-26 series 4-0. Detroit is without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), while Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back fracture).
